(II) The Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal involved five states
(III) The Narmada Water Disputes Tribunal involved Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan

faqs.e: The Narmada Water Disputes Tribunal involved Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra, not Punjab and Haryana.

(III) Adjudicating water disputes with binding effect

faqs.e: Binding adjudication of water disputes falls under Article 262 and its tribunals, not the advisory duties of an Article 263 council.
